comments.body:
Second historical counterexample search complete. The forward floor is judged by soundness; history was used only to find legitimate matches. Corpus predicate for a counterexample: status=closed AND both plan-review and completion-verifier attestations present.

RESULT TABLE

1. Nonempty AC checkbox item — RETAIN AS HARD CLARITY FLOOR.
Detection after revision: inside an exact `## Acceptance Criteria` section, parse standard `- [ ]` / `- [x]` items, join continuation lines until the next item/H2, strip whitespace, and fail only if the resulting item body is empty. Search result: zero historical counterexamples. Important precision control: a blank first line with nonblank wrapped continuation is nonempty. This does not claim proof of soundness, but the state is structurally incapable of naming an outcome.

2. Exact duplicate normalized AC items — REMOVE FROM HARD FLOOR; OPTIONAL ADVISORY ONLY.
Counterexample: 8d27-7ee1-f137-4b88, closed with both attestations, contains the exact AC twice: ``make lint && make typecheck && make test` pass on the landed result.` It is a parent-wide global gate repeated after additional criteria were appended. The duplication is redundant but does not make the plan ambiguous or unexecutable. A floor failure would be false positive. If retained at all, emit “duplicate AC text” coaching with both locations.

3. Bare unresolved sentinel — RETAIN ONLY IN STRUCTURAL ASSIGNMENT FORM; REMOVE THE UNDEFINED HISTORY EXCEPTION.
Broad bare-word search found one active-section match: c244-ba53-6280-4702 says a grep returns “NO stale TODO”; this is a removal assertion and is correctly excluded. No signed+completed counterexample remained after exclusions. Revised hard pattern scans only exact current `Approach`, `Scope`, `Testing`, and `Acceptance Criteria` sections, outside fences/inline code, and fires only when the sentinel occupies an unresolved value position: (a) starts a bullet/line (`TBD: ...`, `TODO — ...`, `???`), (b) follows `:` or `=`, or (c) follows `is`/`remains`/`left`. Suppress a same-line negated/removal assertion (`no`, `zero`, `remove`, `delete`, `reject`, `forbid`, `must not`, `without`). Searches for TBD/TODO/FIXME/??? found zero counterexamples to this narrowed predicate. Do NOT use the earlier “superseded/history section” exclusion; it was undefined. Exact active headings provide the deterministic boundary.

4. Nonempty path/reason in present file-impact entries — REMOVE FROM CLARITY; KEEP AS WRITE-SCHEMA VALIDATION.
Search found zero malformed entries among signed+completed tickets. However this is structured-data integrity, not plan clarity, and should be rejected at `set-file-impact`/event validation. Absence remains allowed. Duplicating the invariant in a score adds no clarity signal.

5. `[rebar:<id>]` direct-edge validation — REMOVE FROM RAW CLARITY; RETAIN ONLY IN THE GROUNDING EXCEPTION PATH.
Naive direct-edge checking is disproven. Ticket 6673-7636-a116-4f90 (both attestations) cites S2 `ce4d...` transitively through direct prerequisite S3 `94f9...`, and cites follow-up `4af8...` while splitting downstream scope. Ticket 94f9 likewise cites downstream S4/S5 tickets in Context/Scope. These are valid provenance/decomposition references, not attempts to ground absent symbols. Revised rule: only invoke edge validation when the code-grounding oracle says a cited file/symbol is absent at the attested base AND the plan is using `[rebar:id]` to claim the prerequisite will create it. Then require the citation id to resolve and have the documented direct upstream edge. Ordinary provenance, transitive context, and downstream/out-of-scope references are inert. Search of all signed+completed citation-bearing plans found no counterexample to this narrowed absence-credit predicate, though history alone cannot prove it sound. This belongs to G1G2/E4 grounding, not the clarity score.

FINAL RECOMMENDATION
Hard additions to clarity: exactly two — (A) nonempty parsed AC items and (B) unresolved sentinel assignments in active execution sections with the explicit structural exclusions above.

Existing hard floor retained: at least one standard AC checklist item.

Advisory only: preferred section presence/aliases, per-AC proof coverage, duplicate ACs, compound/vague/hedged text, testing-shape, and file-impact absence.

Other subsystem invariants: malformed present file-impact -> write validation; `[rebar:id]` edge checking -> grounding exception path only.

Historical negative controls to add if implemented: c244 must PASS the sentinel rule (“NO stale TODO” removal assertion); 8d27 must not hard-fail for a duplicate global gate; 6673 and 94f9 must not fail for provenance/downstream citations; an empty or whitespace-only fully joined AC item must FAIL.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
The first proposal mixed forward validity with historical convention. Revise it to a small deterministic floor intended to have no false positives, then use accepted history only as an adversarial counterexample corpus.

## Approach
Test failure patterns rather than preferred prose style. A rule qualifies for the floor only when the detected state is structurally incompatible with an executable plan; otherwise it remains advisory. Search closed tickets carrying signed plan-review and completion evidence, inspect every matching candidate in context, and narrow or remove any rule with a legitimate match.

## Criteria Under Review
1. An Acceptance Criteria checkbox must contain non-whitespace text after the checkbox marker.
2. Two Acceptance Criteria items must not be exact duplicates after joining continuations and normalizing whitespace/case.
3. Active execution prose must not contain a bare unresolved sentinel (`TBD`, `TODO`, `FIXME`, or `???`) in Approach, Scope, Testing, or Acceptance Criteria; ignore fenced code, inline code, quotations, examples, explicit removal/prohibition assertions, and superseded/history sections.
4. Structured file-impact entries, when present, must have a nonempty path and nonempty reason; absence of file impact is allowed.
5. A `[rebar:<id>]` prerequisite citation used as plan evidence must resolve to a direct verified upstream dependency; ignore literal examples in code spans/fences.

## Scope
Read-only ticket-store analysis. The only mutation is the final findings comment on this ticket; no repository files or other ticket material will be changed.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every criterion under review has a documented historical search and cited matching tickets, verified by the final findings comment.
- [ ] Every legitimate matching ticket is treated as a counterexample and causes the rule to be narrowed or rejected, verified by before/after detection wording in the final findings.
- [ ] The final recommendation clearly separates hard-floor rules from advisory signals, verified by a structured classification table in the final findings.
- [ ] If a rule has no historical match, the finding says that explicitly without claiming proof of soundness, verified by the final findings comment.
compiled_state.title: Adversarially validate a revised deterministic clarity floor
